findings.title: The queued timestamp is fixed at module import
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated when this module is imported, not each time an `AssignmentSource` is created. As a result, sources created later in the process all carry the same stale `queued` value, so the timestamp serialized with outbound sync tasks does not reflect when the assignment was queued. Use a `default_factory` to generate it per instance.
